query:
SELECT DISTINCT tt.document_id
            FROM UNNEST($2::text[], $3::int4[]) AS refs(team_slug, task_num)
            JOIN team t
                ON t.id = $1
                AND LOWER(t.slug) = LOWER(refs.team_slug)
            JOIN team_task tt ON tt.team_id = t.id AND tt.task_num = refs.task_num
